graph.title: Relation Graph
graph.extract_this_entry: Let your companion remember the people and events in this entry
graph.extract_this_done: Remembered the people and events in this entry
graph.extract_queued: Queued {{count}} diaries for background extract — you can leave this page
graph.extract_queued_one: Queued for background extract — you can keep writing
graph.search_empty: Enter a keyword to search graph entities
graph.search_semantic_empty: No semantically similar nodes. Nodes without embeddings do not appear in semantic search.
graph.search_embedding_required: Configure an embedding model before searching nodes by meaning
graph.global_view_hint: Leave the current local view and show all nodes in this month range. Does not change the month range.
graph.show_isolated_nodes_hint: Turn off to keep isolated nodes on the canvas without names. Selected, searched, and focused nodes still show names.
graph.max_nodes_hint: The canvas loads at most this many nodes. The last tick means no cap. Pending nodes in the current month still come in so review is not skipped.
graph.profile_hint: Used to recognize “I” in diaries. Renaming syncs the self person node and keeps the old name as an alias—no full graph rebuild.
graph.profile_saved_synced: Saved and synced the self node in the graph
graph.no_direct_edges: No direct relations for this node
graph.similar_empty: No similar nodes waiting for a merge decision
graph.similar_hint: These nodes have similar names or meanings. Please confirm whether they refer to the same entity—merge them if they match, or keep them apart.
graph.confirm_keep_apart: Are you sure they are not the same person? They will be kept apart and won't be suggested for merging again.
graph.confirm_keep_apart_named: Are you sure "{{name1}}" and "{{name2}}" are not the same person? They will be kept apart and won't be suggested for merging again.
graph.confirm_merge_all_similar: This will merge all {{count}} similar pending nodes ({{groups}} groups). Merging cannot be undone; relations from merged nodes will be moved to the surviving node.
graph.mobile_canvas_paused_title: Graph canvas is not shown on mobile yet
graph.mobile_canvas_paused_body: Open the desktop app to view the relation graph. You can still organize and review pending relations here.
graph.pending_hint: Approving a relation also approves its endpoints. Approving a node also approves its pending relations. Select items to review them in batch.
graph.confirm_approve_all: Approve all {{count}} pending items? Approving a node also approves its pending relations.
graph.confirm_reject_selected: Reject the {{count}} selected items? Rejecting a node also rejects its connected relations.
graph.confirm_reject_all: Reject all {{count}} pending items? Rejecting a node also rejects its connected relations.
graph.click_node_for_detail: Click a node to see details
graph.empty_nodes: No graph nodes yet. Organize diaries or add relations on desktop.
graph.empty_guide_title: Your relation graph is not organized yet
graph.empty_guide_body: {{count}} entries still need organizing. Starting memory organize will fill embeddings and build the relation graph.
graph.legend_pending: Dashed relations are hidden from your companion until you approve them.
graph.legend_pending_edge: Located this relation: both endpoints and the connecting line are highlighted. Click empty space to clear.
graph.legend_focus: Node selected: direct relations highlighted. Click empty space to clear; drag empty space to pan.
graph.legend_focus_depth: Selected: highlighting {{depth}}-hop neighborhood ({{count}} nodes). Click empty space to clear.
graph.legend_month: Showing the last 3 months by default. Adjust the month range above.
graph.focus_depth_hint: When a node is selected, highlight N hops of neighbors (1=direct, 2=one more layer)
graph.month_range_dialog_hint: Pick a start month, then an end month. The graph shows relations in this window.
graph.month_empty_title: No relations in this month range
graph.month_empty_body: Showing {{start}} — {{end}}. Widen the range, or extract diaries first.
graph.edit_saved: Saved (manual edits are kept across re-extraction)
graph.confirm_delete_node: Delete this node? Related edges will be deleted too.
graph.suspect_pending_hint: Suspect nodes may mix several real-world people. Clear suspicion if it is one person; open it and split if it should be several.
graph.self_name_title: Set your name in the graph
graph.self_name_desc: Graph extraction needs to know who “I” refers to in your diaries. Enter the name you want to appear in the relationship graph.
graph.self_name_required: Please set your nickname in Profile before organizing
graph.awaken_welcome_body: We’ll organize people and connections from your diaries. Tell us who “I” is, so the companion can recognize you accurately.
graph.awaken_form_body: This is saved to your profile and used to identify “I” during graph extraction.
graph.extract_concurrency_hint: Up to 10 diaries call the model at once. After 10 drafts or when the batch ends, candidates above {{similarity}}% similarity are recalled and the model decides merges before writing.
graph.extract_help_aria: About extract and the extract pool
graph.extract_help_extract: AI analyzes diary content to extract entities and relationships. This number sets concurrency: higher values speed up extraction but consume more API concurrency quota.
graph.extract_help_pool:
Extracted drafts are staged in the pool before writing to the graph:

Whenever {{pool}} entries accumulate or the current batch finishes, AI compares them with existing nodes to merge duplicate people or places, keeping entities unified.
graph.extract_parse_failed: The model output could not be parsed as extract JSON
graph.extract_embedding_required: Configure an embedding model and embed this diary before extracting the graph.
graph.extract_diary_not_embedded: This diary has no embedding yet. Embed it first, then extract.
graph.extract_skipped_not_embedded: {{count}} diaries are not embedded yet and were skipped.
graph.extract_blocked_pending_embed: {{count}} diary entries are not embedded yet. Fill in the embeddings before organizing relations.
graph.confirm_batch_extract: Queue {{count}} diaries. Up to {{concurrency}} will run in parallel. After 10 drafts or when the batch ends, candidates above {{similarity}}% similarity are recalled and the model decides merges before writing.
graph.entry_node_requires_diary_path: entry nodes must be based on a diary path; do not create a random id by hand
graph.node_review_open_hint: Tap to open the review page for pending, similar, and re-extract nodes.
graph.merge_irreversible_warning: Merging cannot be undone. Merged nodes will be combined into the kept node, relations will be reattached to the kept node, and only the target node will remain after syncing.
graph.node_detail_empty: Select a node to see its name and summary
graph.process_pending_reextract_hint: Add current pending diaries to the organize queue
graph.extract_one_hint: Pick an existing diary and force it into the organize queue. System-written relations are replaced; relations you edited stay.
graph.confirm_extract_one: This adds {{date}} to the organize queue. System-written relations are replaced; relations you edited stay.
graph.extract_one_not_found: There is no diary for this day, or its path is not in the index yet.
graph.clear_life_hint: Deletes every node, relation, and extract record in this workspace’s life relation graph. Notebook graphs are not changed.
graph.clear_life_confirm_input: This deletes every node, relation, and extract record in this workspace’s life relation graph, including edits you made. After sync, other devices become empty too. Notebook graphs are not changed. Type “{{phrase}}” to confirm:
graph.clear_life_mismatch: The text did not match. The action was cancelled.
graph.same_name_save_blocked: A node named “{{name}}” already exists. Rename this one, or merge it into that node.
graph.source_not_found: Diary source for that day was not found
graph.split_node_title: Split this name into two people
graph.split_node_hint: First write how the new one differs from the original. Then keep each relation on the original, give it to the new one, or skip it for now. Skipped relations can be finished later.
graph.split_label: How the new one should appear
graph.split_summary: One-line intro for the new one
graph.split_edges_heading: Who do these relations belong to
graph.split_not_ready: This node is not ready. Close and open again.
graph.split_edges_empty: This node has no relations to assign yet
graph.split_label_required: Write how the new one should appear
graph.same_name_exists: A node named “{{name}}” already exists. Open it, register another entity, or choose a different name.
graph.revert_split_confirm: Undo the split for “{{label}}”? Its relations return to the original node and this registration is removed.
graph.queue_modal_hint: Closing this window does not stop the job. You can keep adding diaries.
